verdict.rationale: Moss documents indexes that can be created, loaded several at a time, and deleted. Nothing in the evidence presents namespaces, partitions, or per-tenant collections as a tenant-isolation mechanism, and no limits on tenant or index counts are documented. The only documented limit, 20 web sources per index, is about crawl sources, not tenancy. Using one index per tenant would be a user-side arrangement, not documented multi-tenancy support.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can isolate many tenants cheaply using namespaces, partitions, or per-tenant collections with documented limits
